E_LATTICE.paraphrase: Graded lattice compression, unloading and staged thermal recovery are shown; layer naming conflicts are retained.

E_MODULAR.paraphrase: Hinge distribution and orientation determine strip configurations, including M, square and waves.

E_HELIX.paraphrase: Oriented hinges generate helices at two reported applied strains.

E_HAND.paraphrase: Printed hand joints are locally cold-programmable; this is a polymer demonstrator, not a biological experiment.

E_LOCAL.paraphrase: Local strip hinges can be programmed separately; holes support controlled loading and interlocking.

E_ELECTRIC.paraphrase: Vacuum-assisted EGaIn channel filling supports a qualitative illuminated-LED demonstration through shown shapes.

E_PANEL.paraphrase: Dual-axis panel layouts are programmed in x, y and both directions.

E_SYMMETRIC.paraphrase: Symmetric and inverted hinge placement give different buckling configurations.

E_INTERLOCK.paraphrase: Through-hole interlocking combines shape-morphed components into architectures.

E_SWITCH.paraphrase: H13/H12/H23 constituent combinations have different passive responses to temperature.

E_HYBRID.paraphrase: Two hybrid layouts show M-to-S and square-to-helix thermal transitions.

E_PIPE.paraphrase: Micro-hinge pipe shape and thermal response are shown; pictured flow is not quantified.

E_ALT.paraphrase: Alternative-resin stiff/soft tensile curves and hinge bending are shown; one component label is ambiguous.

E_MATCYCLE.paraphrase: Ten material shape-memory cycles for B1 and B2 are shown; a separate complete cycle recipe is not specified.

E_LATTICE.paraphrase: Graded lattice compression, unloading and staged thermal recovery are shown; layer naming conflicts are retained.

E_HINGE.paraphrase: Homogeneous B1 shape-fixity data, composite hinge strain-angle data and hinge-family force-displacement measurements are reported. Five experimental results support the hinge-angle error bars only.

E_HINGECYCLE.paraphrase: H13 is shown over forty cold-draw/recovery cycles with selected photographed checkpoints.

E_MODULAR.paraphrase: Hinge distribution and orientation determine strip configurations, including M, square and waves.

E_HELIX.paraphrase: Oriented hinges generate helices at two reported applied strains.

E_HAND.paraphrase: Printed hand joints are locally cold-programmable; this is a polymer demonstrator, not a biological experiment.

E_LOCAL.paraphrase: Local strip hinges can be programmed separately; holes support controlled loading and interlocking.

E_ELECTRIC.paraphrase: Vacuum-assisted EGaIn channel filling supports a qualitative illuminated-LED demonstration through shown shapes.

E_PANEL.paraphrase: Dual-axis panel layouts are programmed in x, y and both directions.

E_SYMMETRIC.paraphrase: Symmetric and inverted hinge placement give different buckling configurations.

E_INTERLOCK.paraphrase: Through-hole interlocking combines shape-morphed components into architectures.

E_SWITCH.paraphrase: H13/H12/H23 constituent combinations have different passive responses to temperature.

E_HYBRID.paraphrase: Two hybrid layouts show M-to-S and square-to-helix thermal transitions.

E_PIPE.paraphrase: Micro-hinge pipe shape and thermal response are shown; pictured flow is not quantified.
